place.en: The hidden realm · The cliff wall

setup.zh: 头顶传来脚步声。马小宝和那五个人，带着一盘麻绳，顺着崖壁爬下来：「秘境里死个把人，可不稀奇。」你背后是墙，左手是不见底的崖口。
setup.en: Footsteps overhead. Ma Xiaobao and his five come climbing down the cliff with a coil of hemp rope. "People die in the hidden realm now and then." The wall is at your back; on your left, a drop with no bottom.

recap.zh: 马小宝六个人追下崖来，揍了你二十三下，要把你推下凶崖。你拼着最后一口气按下阵眼，六个人给拍在了崖壁上。你知道怎么开，只说了一句「三天」。
recap.en: Ma Xiaobao and his five came down the cliff, gave you twenty-three blows and meant to push you off the Cliff of Danger. With the last of your strength you pressed the binding's eye, and the six were slapped against the rock. You knew how to open it, and said only: "Three days."

zh: 崖壁上，亮起一圈淡淡的光。
六个人，贴在崖壁上。一盘麻绳，悬在半空。
en: A faint ring of light glows on the cliff.
Six people stuck to the rock. A coil of rope hangs in the air.

story.zh:
小满抬头一看，崖顶上站着一排人，不多不少，正好六个。当中那个胖墩墩的，身上的新法衣在黑地里也看得出是簇新的，正是马小宝；他身后五个，便是柴房那天夜里的五个，卖地图的那两个在里头，老蔫也在里头，肩上那一大盘麻绳，已经卸下来，抄在那个抄着手的跟班手里。马小宝居高临下：「沈小满，你以为躲到这儿来，我就找不到你了吗？」他冲身后那个跟班一扬下巴，「你一进门，就有人给我报信了。原来你是个识货的——那面墙，开了？」小满站在墙前，没有说话。马小宝往他脚边那道黑沉沉的崖口望了一眼，又望回来，声音倒不响了：「秘境里头，死个把人，可不稀奇。门口躺着的那个锦袍的，谁多看了一眼？十年前下去三个，上来一个。今年嘛，里头还掺着外人——少上来一个，谁也不会多说一句。」说罢，领着五个人，顺着崖壁往下爬。

碎石子哗啦啦地响，六个人下到了石台上。他才二层，左臂叫蛫咬穿了；还了一拳，那只补着黑布的鞋头便踹在他左肋上，正踹在那根没长牢的骨头上，他趴了下去。马小宝不动手，站在后头数，老蔫站在最后头，没有抬脚。数到「二十三」，马小宝道：「柴房的数，凑齐了。」他朝崖口一扬下巴：「推下去。他要是扒住崖沿，捆了手再推。」两个人拖着他的脚往崖口去，那个抄着手的，蹲下去解那盘麻绳。

他这时候才真正明白过来：这一回，是要他的命。

银月没有打哈欠。她在他衣襟里，声音又低又快：「左手边那块石头。按下去。」他的手在地上乱抓，抓着了一块圆石，半埋在土里，石面上有九个浅浅的小坑，横三竖三，八个坑里嵌着石子，正中那一个是空的。他来不及问，拼着最后一口气，一掌按了下去。那石头往下一沉。

崖壁上登时亮起一圈淡淡的光，青白青白的，从崖脚一直亮到崖顶，像是有人拿一支极大的笔，在那面崖上画了一个圈。圈一亮，石台上那六个人脚底一轻，像给一只看不见的大手一把抄起来，一个个拍在了崖壁上，手脚张开，脸朝着石头，任他们怎么挣，怎么蹬，就是挪不动半分。离石台最近的那个，脚尖只差一尺便落了地。那盘麻绳从抄着手的跟班手里滑脱了，一圈一圈散开，悬在半空里，也不动了。马小宝贴在最当中，只能拿眼角往下斜着看，叫道：「你——你干了什么！」

小满没有答。他趴在地上，半天爬不起来。银月在他耳朵里道：「前人留下的困阵，护这面墙的：阵起那一下，把阵里的人都拍上崖壁，按阵眼的那一个除外；往后，粘的是崖壁上的人。不去动它，它要粘到秘境关门——三天以后，石门合上前一个时辰，才自己松开。阵眼就在你手底下。九个坑，缺个中——你往正中按一下，它现在就开。」

马小宝挣了半天，挣得满头大汗，脸上那点凶相一点一点地化了，声音软了下来：「沈……沈师弟。咱们一个村出来的。你把我们放下来，我给你十两银子。」小满没有说话。马小宝道：「二十两！」小满还是没有说话。马小宝憋了半天，道：「那……那公中，往后你不用交了！」

小满抬起头来，一个一个看过去。看那个抄着手的，看那个踹他右边肋骨的，看那盘悬在半空里的麻绳，看马小宝。末了，他看着离崖口最近的那一个。老蔫贴在崖壁的最外沿，半边身子悬在那道黑口子的上头，一声也没出，只拿眼角往下望着他。

他知道怎么开。正中那个空坑，他只要伸一根指头。可开，是六个人一齐开；这道阵不认得谁说过「够了」，谁带了绳子。
story.en:
Xiaoman looked up: on the cliff top stood a row of people, six exactly. The plump one in the middle, his new robe brand-new even in the dark, was Ma Xiaobao; the five behind him were the five from the woodshed night — the two map sellers among them, Old Wilt among them, and the big coil of rope was off his shoulder now and in the hands of the follower with folded arms. Ma Xiaobao looked down: "Shen Xiaoman, did you think if you hid down here I couldn't find you?" He jerked his chin at that follower. "The moment you went in, someone came and told me. So you know a good thing when you see it — that wall, it's open?" Xiaoman stood before the wall and said nothing. Ma Xiaobao glanced at the black drop by Xiaoman's feet and back again, and his voice was no longer loud: "In the hidden realm people die now and then. Nothing strange in it. That one in brocade lying back by the entrance — who gave him a second look? Ten years ago three went down and one came up. This year — there are outsiders in here too. One fewer comes up, and nobody says a word." And he led the five down the cliff.

Pebbles clattered, and the six were down on the ledge. He was only at layer two, his left arm bitten through by the gui; he got one punch in, and then the shoe with the black-cloth patch kicked him in the left ribs, right on the bone that hadn't knit, and he went down. Ma Xiaobao didn't lift a hand; he stood at the back and counted. Old Wilt stood at the very back and didn't raise a foot. At "twenty-three" Ma Xiaobao said: "That's the woodshed's count made up." He jerked his chin at the drop. "Push him off. If he catches the edge, tie his hands and push again." Two of them dragged him by the feet toward the drop, and the one with folded arms crouched to undo the coil of rope.

Only now did he truly understand: this time, they meant to kill him.

Yinyue didn't yawn. From inside his coat her voice came low and quick: "The stone by your left hand. Press it." His hand clawed at the ground and caught a round stone half sunk in the earth, nine shallow hollows in its face, three by three, stones set in eight, the middle one empty. He had no time to ask; with the last of his strength he slammed his palm down on it. The stone sank.

A faint ring of light lit up the cliff, blue-white, from foot to top, as if someone had drawn a circle on it with an enormous brush. The moment it lit, the six on the ledge went light underfoot, as if snatched up by a great invisible hand, and were slapped one by one against the cliff, limbs spread, faces to the stone, and however they strained and kicked, they couldn't shift an inch. The one nearest the ledge was a foot from touching down. The coil of rope slipped from the folded-arms follower's hands, opened loop by loop, and hung in the air, still. Ma Xiaobao, stuck in the middle, could only squint down sideways: "You — what did you do!"

Xiaoman didn't answer. He lay on the ground and couldn't get up. Yinyue said in his ear: "A binding the old ones left to guard this wall: when it wakes it slaps everyone inside it onto the cliff, all but the one on its eye; after that, it holds whoever is on the cliff. Leave it be, and it holds until the realm closes — three days from now, an hour before the stone door shuts, it lets go by itself." She paused. "Its eye is under your hand. Nine hollows, the middle one missing — press the middle and it opens now."

Ma Xiaobao struggled a long while till the sweat poured off him, and the menace in his face melted bit by bit; his voice went soft: "Sh… Shen, little brother. We're from the same village. Let us down and I'll give you ten taels." Xiaoman said nothing. "Twenty!" Xiaoman still said nothing. After a long struggle: "Then… then the common fund — you won't have to pay it any more!"

Xiaoman raised his head and looked at them one by one. At the one with folded arms, at the one who had kicked his right ribs, at the coil of rope hanging in the air, at Ma Xiaobao. Last, he looked at the one nearest the drop. Old Wilt hung at the very outer edge of the cliff, half his body over that black mouth; he made not a sound, only looked down at him from the corner of his eye.

He knew how to open it. The empty hollow in the middle — he had only to put out one finger. But open meant all six at once; this binding didn't know who had said "Enough" and who had brought the rope.

exits.means: leaves them stuck for three days and goes through the wall

story.zh:
小满把手从那块石头上挪开，扶着墙站起来，道：「三天。」

说完，他转过身去，走进了那道墙。

身后，马小宝先是骂，骂他祖宗，骂他娘，骂到后来，骂成了求，求到后来，什么也听不清了。老蔫一句话也没有说。小满走在那道墙缝里，一步，两步，脚底下发飘，像踩在棉花上。他这辈子打过兔子、打过獐子，头一回，把六个人撂在了一道崖上；其中一个，一个时辰以前，刚在他耳朵边上说过一句「绳子，是带给你的」。
story.en:
Xiaoman took his hand off the stone, pulled himself up by the wall, and said: "Three days."

And with that he turned and walked into the wall.

Behind him Ma Xiaobao cursed first — cursed his ancestors, cursed his mother — and the cursing turned to begging, and the begging turned to something no one could make out. Old Wilt said not a word. Xiaoman walked through the gap in the wall, one step, two, his feet unsteady, as if on cotton. He had shot hares and shot river deer; for the first time in his life he had left six people hanging on a cliff — and one of them, not two hours before, had said in his ear: "The rope — it's for you."
